rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
noun forming second member of compound with aṣṭa
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal or kingly.
It possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is characterized as a royal, eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact referent of rājānam as an epithet or apposition is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
